mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Let’s take a moment to imagine what it feels like when the small, everyday moments of aging suddenly make you laugh, or pause, or even roll your eyes. That’s exactly what we’ll explore together, as we step into the witty, heartfelt world that Nora Ephron created in her book, I Feel Bad About My Neck, And Other Thoughts on Being a Woman. Think about it: the ever-changing beauty routines, the quirks of growing older, and those little things you maybe never thought you’d care about—like finding the perfect purse, or realizing your moisturizer just isn’t cutting it anymore. But there’s more than just the funny side here. We’ll also dive into the stories that touch on friendship, love, and the way our relationships with our own bodies shift as the years go by. Together, we’ll find the humor, the honesty, and the surprising comfort in knowing that we’re not alone in our anxieties—or our triumphs—as we move through life’s later chapters. So, as we uncover the joys and the struggles, you’ll see how the ordinary can suddenly become extraordinary—and how there’s real beauty in embracing imperfection, sharing a laugh, and celebrating all the unexpected adventures that come with time. Let’s dive in, and discover what it truly means to grow older, together.
